OrgHome
Template.Design:
@using Umbraco.Cms.Web.Common.PublishedModels @inherits Umbraco.Cms.Web.Common.Views.UmbracoViewPage @{ Layout = "layout.cshtml"; var organizationCode = @Model.Name.Replace("-",""); string organizationName; string organizationBadgeCss; string organizationIntro; string organizationSecondaryText; if (organizationCode == "OrgB") { organizationName = "Organization B"; organizationBadgeCss = "bg-success-subtle text-success border border-success-subtle"; organizationIntro = "This area is dedicated to members of Organization B."; organizationSecondaryText = "This page demonstrates that the same Umbraco instance can serve multiple " + "organizations with isolated content and access rules, powered by virtual users."; } else { organizationCode = "OrgA"; // fallback organizationName = "Organization A"; organizationBadgeCss = "bg-primary-subtle text-primary border border-primary-subtle"; organizationIntro = "Content and navigation are restricted to members of Organization A."; organizationSecondaryText = "If you can see this page, authorization for Organization A has been " + "successfully applied. This area can host content, tools, and dashboards " + "that are only relevant to A�s users."; } ViewData["Title"] = organizationName; ViewData["CurrentSite"] = organizationCode; }

@organizationName space

@organizationIntro

@organizationCode

Welcome to @organizationName

@organizationSecondaryText

@(organizationCode == "OrgB" ? "B-specific dashboard" : "Internal documents")

@(organizationCode == "OrgB" ? "Mock dashboard cards and KPIs for this organization." : "Example section for organization-specific documentation and knowledge base.")

@(organizationCode == "OrgB" ? "News & updates" : "Announcements")

@(organizationCode == "OrgB" ? "Sample news feed visible only for this tenant." : "News, updates, and important messages dedicated to this organization.")

Tools & links

Quick access to systems that only @organizationName users should see.

In a production setup, access to this node would be controlled by virtual users and membership in @organizationName (@organizationCode).
